ITEM 1 | Slice of bread, roughly triangular wedge with rounded crust edge, golden-brown crust, pale cream interior with fine dark speckles, matte dry surface, sits at upper right of plate, about 10 cm long and 2 cm thick, footprint about one-eighth of plate | 45
ITEM 2 | Watermelon pieces, bright red flesh with darker red edges and small cream-colored seeds visible, juicy-looking moist sheen, cut into irregular cubes/wedges about 3 to 4 cm across and 2 cm thick, arranged in a cluster at right side of plate next to bread | 150
ITEM 3 | Chopped salad mix, diced pale green cucumber cubes about 1 cm, diced red and orange bell pepper pieces, and finely torn dark green leafy herbs or greens, mixed together in a loose pile, slightly glossy with some moisture, mound about 8 cm wide and 1.5 cm high, lower left of plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Dressing or moisture residue, faint light brownish smear on plate surface near the salad and bread, thin and translucent, no visible pooling | 5
